concerns.text: Task T019a implements strict 5‑fold CV but omits the required stratification by solvent type mandated by FR‑004, thereby weakening the functional requirement.

Task T047 (Verified Dataset Registry) is marked as incomplete; without this registry the project lacks traceability of the data source, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and breaking the requirement for a permanent, verifiable record of the dataset.

The contract test T035_test is flagged as UNRESOLVED‑CLAIM, leaving SC‑003 (runtime measurement) and SC‑005 (memory usage) without a verified artifact; this drops the acceptance criterion that resource summary JSON must be validated.
